title: Traditional Pastrmajlija with Croatian Twist
description: A popular Croatian meat pie filled with ground pork and topped with a crusty crust, giving it a rich and savory flavor. This recipe is a twist on the traditional Croatian version, adding a modern touch to a classic dish.

ingredients.name: Pastrmajlija Crust Mix
ingredients.notes: available at most European grocery stores

instructions: In a large pan, cook ground pork over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add finely chopped onion to the pan and cook until translucent.
Stir in Pastrmajlija Crust Mix and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together grated cheese, softened butter, and beaten egg.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the top of the meat mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
